description: An object of functions that build keys from a root, e.g. `userKeys.detail(id)`. Keeps keys consistent and makes prefix invalidation reliable.
Transforms cached data per observer. Several components can share one query and request while each subscribes to its own projection.
A query that needs data from another one. Use `skipToken` (type-safe) or `enabled: false` until its input exists.
Passed as `queryFn` to skip a query. The query stays pending without fetching until a real function is provided.
TanStack Query keeps unchanged parts of new data referentially equal to the old data, so memoized consumers and `select` results stay stable.
`placeholderData` shows temporary data (e.g. `keepPreviousData`) without caching it; `initialData` seeds the cache, for example from a list entry.
